solver_code:
from ortools.sat.python import cp_model
import math
import json

def main():
    M = 5
    capacity = 50
    
    sectors_data = [
        [37, 87, 2],
        [73, 18, 1],
        [74, 40, 2],
        [1, 11, 3],
        [30, 32, 1],
        [9, 91, 1],
        [24, 13, 2],
        [98, 43, 2],
        [30, 42, 2],
        [78, 20, 1],
        [58, 57, 1],
        [25, 5, 2],
        [20, 3, 3],
        [13, 61, 1],
        [12, 74, 1],
        [10, 91, 2],
        [51, 17, 1],
        [84, 77, 3],
        [92, 5, 3],
        [95, 54, 1],
        [42, 69, 1],
        [25, 21, 1],
        [27, 31, 1],
        [95, 27, 1],
        [28, 90, 1],
        [27, 56, 1],
        [10, 6, 2],
        [39, 33, 2],
        [58, 82, 2],
        [12, 11, 3],
        [3, 52, 3],
        [31, 12, 3],
        [74, 59, 3],
        [52, 50, 2],
        [33, 97, 3],
        [9, 31, 2],
        [10, 1, 2],
        [22, 84, 2],
        [2, 3, 1],
        [90, 7, 1],
        [32, 96, 1],
        [93, 38, 1],
        [51, 38, 2],
        [8, 44, 2],
        [15, 66, 2],
        [69, 1, 1],
        [57, 25, 2],
        [4, 52, 2],
        [51, 93, 3],
        [53, 29, 3]
    ]
    
    S = len(sectors_data)
    east = [sectors_data[i][0] for i in range(S)]
    north = [sectors_data[i][1] for i in range(S)]
    demand = [sectors_data[i][2] for i in range(S)]
    
    distance_cost = [[0.0 for _ in range(S)] for _ in range(S)]
    for i in range(S):
        for j in range(S):
            dx = east[i] - east[j]
            dy = north[i] - north[j]
            distance = math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy)
            distance_cost[i][j] = demand[i] * distance
    
    model = cp_model.CpModel()
    
    facility_placed = [model.NewBoolVar(f"facility_placed_{j}") for j in range(S)]
    
    assign = [[model.NewBoolVar(f"assign_{i}_{j}") for j in range(S)] for i in range(S)]
    
    model.Add(sum(facility_placed) == M)
    
    for i in range(S):
        for j in range(S):
            model.Add(assign[i][j] <= facility_placed[j])
    
    for i in range(S):
        model.Add(sum(assign[i][j] for j in range(S)) == 1)
    
    for j in range(S):
        model.Add(sum(demand[i] * assign[i][j] for i in range(S)) <= capacity)
    
    objective_terms = []
    for i in range(S):
        for j in range(S):
            objective_terms.append(int(round(distance_cost[i][j] * 1000)) * assign[i][j])
    
    model.Minimize(sum(objective_terms))
    
    solver = cp_model.CpSolver()
    solver.parameters.max_time_in_seconds = 90.0
    solver.parameters.num_search_workers = 0
    
    status = solver.Solve(model)
    
    if status in (cp_model.OPTIMAL, cp_model.FEASIBLE):
        env_impact = 0.0
        for i in range(S):
            for j in range(S):
                if solver.Value(assign[i][j]) == 1:
                    env_impact += distance_cost[i][j]
        
        selected_facilities = []
        for j in range(S):
            if solver.Value(facility_placed[j]) == 1:
                selected_facilities.append(j + 1)
        
        sector_assignments = []
        for i in range(S):
            for j in range(S):
                if solver.Value(assign[i][j]) == 1:
                    facility_index = selected_facilities.index(j + 1) + 1
                    sector_assignments.append(facility_index)
                    break
        
        print(json.dumps({
            "environmental_impact_score": round(env_impact, 3),
            "molecular_facility_coordinates": selected_facilities,
            "ecological_service_matrix": sector_assignments
        }))
    else:
        print(json.dumps({
            "environmental_impact_score": None,
            "molecular_facility_coordinates": [],
            "ecological_service_matrix": []
        }))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
